kaikki_vikisozluk.e: طَاقَم or طَاقِم • (ṭāqam or ṭāqim) m (plural طَوَاقِم (ṭawāqim))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish طاقم (takım, “group, crew, set”). Variant: طَقْم (ṭaqm, “arranged set, suit”).
g: staff, crew, team, personnel (human resources working together occupying a facility)
